% ---- paragraph after "The Whole Popularity Range"
\paragraph{A Second Model.} We repeated this check on Gemma-2-9B-it with the same questions, asked with the prompt that invites abstaining, because Gemma rarely says \idk{} without it (the plan was recorded before the run). Knowledge is Gemma's own. Obscurity again raises abstention: $+2.99$ [$+2.35$, $+3.82$], $+2.56$ [$+1.85$, $+3.49$] without the extreme tenths, and $+3.16$ [$+2.50$, $+3.91$] with the regex. Predicted abstention is 0.15 at the 90th percentile of popularity and 0.47 at the 10th. Prompts differ between the two models, so the sizes are not comparable. The result holds for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-it on PopQA.
